_about: Recommended order of roles per flow, for `architect.py recommend FLOW`. Each step: role, job (arch_jobs), tier, ctx (prompt tokens; null = whole window), thinking, escalate (when, to), reason and an evidence tag: measured-here (this machine's runs), vendor (model card) or estimate (reasoned, not measured). Advice only; nothing here changes a setting.

_facts.text: A local 8B model passes about 30-45% of small tasks on its own.
Qwen3.6 MoE is the strongest installed coder but slower.
Qwen2.5-Coder-14B is the code specialist, about 50 tok/s here.
Code fixes the wiring (exports, __main__, __init__); the model writes the logic: about half of failed live builds failed on shape.
Writing tests first gave no gain at n=16.
Thinking on for plan and review, off for edits.

build.title: Build something new from a request

steps.reason: Planning and review are where thinking pays; the plan lists every public name so later sprints agree.
Fix the public names before code: wiring mistakes, not logic, were about half of the failed live builds.

escalate.when: two failed tries on the same sprint

steps.reason: One sprint per module; the model writes the logic, code fixes the wiring (exports, __main__, __init__).
steps.note: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B is the code specialist when installed (~50 tok/s measured here); the 8B alone lands ~30-45% on small tasks.

steps.reason: Tests are written beside the code, not first: test-first gave no gain at n=16.
A reading pass for what tests do not cover; its verdict is re-checked in code.

bugfix.title: Fix a bug from a report or a failing test

steps.reason: Name the cause from the failure text before editing; a wrong fix on a guess costs more than a short think.
The reproduction is a new test file; existing tests stay read-only.

escalate.when: the reproduction still fails after two tries

steps.reason: Smallest edit through DEF or EDIT blocks, thinking off for edits.
steps.note: Small local models fix about 30-45% of small tasks first time; escalation is for the stuck case, not the first try.

steps.reason: Checks that the fix is the cause, not a patch over the test.

feature.title: Add a feature to an existing project

steps.reason: A short spec with acceptance checks keeps the change small.
Contract first, then data, API and UI, so the layers agree; wiring is repaired in code.
Tests after the code (test-first showed no gain at n=16).
One judge pass on the diff.
Name what is wrong (duplication, length) before touching it; the flow rejects an unchanged try.

escalate.when: the shape check or the tests fail twice

steps.reason: Whole-definition DEF blocks keep every other line; green tests alone prove nothing was done, so code checks that the shape changed.

escalate.when: no test survives the full suite after two tries

steps.reason: Tests judged by whether broken code makes them fail; sound tests of a half-right file are kept.
Optional: look for assertions that cannot fail.

review.title: Read a change for risks; advice only

escalate.when: the diff is large and the worker's window cannot hold it

steps.reason: Review is the other place thinking pays; severity-ordered, with file and line.
steps.note: Qwen3.6 MoE is the strongest installed coder but slower: worth it here only when the change is big.

steps.reason: Only where code checks cannot decide.

escalate.when: a finding is still reported after two tries

steps.reason: A static scan supplies file, line and CWE; the model only fixes those, so a small model is enough.
Checks that no validation was removed to make the scan pass.

optimize.title: Speed up code that was measured to be slow

escalate.when: the benchmark does not improve after two tries

steps.reason: Reason from the measurement: pick the algorithmic change, one at a time.
A change counts only if tests stay green and the benchmark improves; code decides, not the model.

hunt.title: Find real defects and prove each with a failing test

escalate.when: no defect is demonstrated on the first pass

steps.reason: Adversarial reading; an unproven suspicion is discarded.
steps.note: Qwen3.6 MoE reads code best of the installed models but is slower; use it for this pass only.

steps.reason: Each defect becomes a failing pytest test; the test is the proof.

design.title: Turn a request into a design and contract

steps.reason: Stay high-level; early plan errors cascade.

escalate.when: the plan check rejects the design twice

steps.reason: Decisions, rejected alternatives, API contract and data model.
steps.note: Planning is low-volume (about two calls a run), so a slower, stronger model costs little here.

steps.reason: Exact public names and errors, so the build agrees with the design.

docs.title: Document code from what it actually does

steps.reason: Plain sentences from the code shown; talks only.
Docstrings and README; may write only *.md, docs/ and README.
